scope.tested: One bounded 96-scenario finite replay model for Part126's SAME-authority generation state machine under a FIXED destination-repository incarnation. A successful generation-advance CAS or successful terminal-effect CAS may lose its response; a third invocation may then perform no action, one further generation handoff, or one terminal effect before exact readback; readback may be rate-limited until the next invocation; duplicate delivery and a late old claimant are independently toggled.
assumptions: Destination repository incarnation is fixed for the whole trace; repository same-name rebind remains orthogonal and unresolved.
Generation advance is exactly +1, monotonic, and contends with terminalization on one current-blob-CAS authority object.
Terminal state is absorbing within this repository-local model; no handoff is allowed after terminalization.
Claimants are cooperative/non-Byzantine. The strong protocol rechecks current generation/claim ownership before terminalization and never lets a stale claimant adopt a newer generation.

A stable transition_id is semantic for one logical generation edge, not one network attempt. In this model T1 denotes the g1-to-g2 edge regardless of which cooperative invocation observes/replays it. A stable effect_id denotes one logical terminal effect.
Rate-limit interruption causes no same-run retry/backoff; exact readback is deferred to a later fair invocation.
not_tested: Repository delete/recreate, transfer, force-rebind, or write-time repository_id binding
Byzantine agents or sinks that ignore generation ownership
Garbage collection or rollback of the authority object after terminalization
Continuous API availability or paid-plan entitlement

model_protocols.stable_semantic_edge_exact_readback: Use deterministic/stable logical transition_id/effect_id, monotonic +1 generation, same-authority current-blob CAS, absorbing terminal state, and generation/claim-owner recheck. After ambiguous handoff success, current generation >= target proves the semantic edge occurred because generations cannot skip or roll back. After ambiguous terminal CAS, terminal effect_id identifies the already-applied effect. A later generation is never adopted by the old claimant.
model_protocols.blind_ambiguous_retry: Negative control: after response loss or duplicate delivery, reread current open authority state and perform another handoff as a fresh attempt instead of recognizing the already-satisfied semantic edge.
model_protocols.last_transition_id_only_fail_closed: Conservative control: store only the most recent attempt-scoped transition_id. If a third handoff overwrites it before readback, do not mutate further but classify the original response as unresolved.
model_protocols.ownership_rebind_on_read: Negative control: after a handoff, permit the old claimant to reread the newer open generation and adopt it before terminalization.

stable_semantic_edge_exact_readback.rate_limited_lost-success_readback_slice: 0/24 unsafe; all 24 defer without same-run retry and resolve on later exact readback under the stated fair-invocation assumption

blind_ambiguous_retry.lost_terminal_effect_response_slice: 0/24 unsafe because repository-local terminal state is absorbing
blind_ambiguous_retry.rate_limited_lost-success_readback_slice: 8/24 unsafe if a later replay treats the current open generation as a fresh handoff target

last_transition_id_only_fail_closed.lost_handoff_response_slice: 8/24 remain unresolved when a third handoff has replaced the last attempt-scoped id
last_transition_id_only_fail_closed.interpretation: Keeping only the latest attempt-scoped id is safe when it fails closed, but it does not provide exact replay classification after intervening legal transitions.

ownership_rebind_on_read.interpretation: Current-state reread is not authority transfer. A stale claimant must not infer ownership of a newer generation merely because it can observe that generation.

finding.new_narrowing: For the fixed-incarnation repository-local state machine, ambiguous CAS success does not require an attempt-specific lease or a blind retry. Safe replay needs a semantic idempotency identity. If each generation transition is exactly +1 and monotonic, a stable logical transition_id can be defined by the generation edge itself: after response loss, observing generation >= n+1 proves that edge n->n+1 has happened, even if a third invocation already advanced again. This avoids the 12/96 fail-closed ambiguity seen when only the latest attempt-scoped transition id is retained. Blind replay is unsafe because it can convert one ambiguous successful handoff into an extra generation advance (24/96 overall; 16/24 in the lost-handoff slice).
finding.terminal_effect_distinction: Within the tested repository-local absorbing-terminal state, lost response after terminal-effect CAS is simpler: exact readback of the stable effect_id is sufficient and no protocol produced duplicate terminalization in the 24 lost-effect scenarios. This does NOT prove idempotency for an external side effect executed outside the authority CAS.
finding.ownership_distinction: Exact readback proves state, not claimant authority. Allowing the old claimant to adopt a newer generation after reread resurrected stale ownership in 16/96 traces. Generation ownership must remain separately fenced even when replay classification is exact.

source_basis.basis: Pure role-local finite-model extension of Part126's already source-qualified file-level current-blob CAS/create-only mechanism contract. No new external API behavior is claimed by Part127.

unresolved_children.detail: The strong replay result assumes owner/name still denotes the same destination repository incarnation at mutation time.
Repository-local terminal-state idempotency does not make a non-repository useful effect idempotent; the sink still needs the same generation/effect fence or equivalent atomic participation.
The generation-edge proof relies on monotonic +1 transitions with no rollback/skip. If authority can skip, rewind, or be garbage-collected, an additional durable semantic witness is required.

zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.richer_mode_protected_manual_execution_d: none for the tested fixed-incarnation repository-local replay protocol; unresolved for repository-incarnation fencing and non-repository effect sinks
zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.rate_limit_behavior: A lost-success plus rate-limit before readback checkpoints ambiguity and waits for a later scheduled invocation; no wall-clock lease expires and no same-run polling/backoff is required.
zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.quota_zero_scope_guard: The model adds no finite compute/storage credit mechanism. It does not prove continuous transport availability or plan entitlement.
